touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Brigg qualifies as a local detour through Brigg Heritage Centre and COUNTY BRIDGE. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Brigg: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
